slides.headline: Is your kitchen breathing properly?
slides.subline: Why every kitchen needs a proper exhaust system.

slides.title: What a proper exhaust system does

items.title: Clears smoke and heat
items.text: Cooking fumes and heat are drawn away from the cooking line instead of building up in the kitchen.

items.title: Carries grease-laden air out
items.text: The hood captures it, and the ducting and fan take it out of the kitchen.

items.title: Supports a better working space
items.text: A cleaner, more comfortable kitchen for your team to work in every day.

slides.title: Who needs one?
slides.intro: Wherever food is cooked, the air has to go somewhere.
slides.note_text: Planning · Design · Manufacturing · Installation · Maintenance · Training

caption_en:
Is your kitchen breathing properly?

Smoke, heat and grease-laden air need a way out. A proper exhaust system clears them from the cooking line and carries them out of the kitchen, so your team can work in a cleaner, more comfortable space.

Whether you run a restaurant, hotel, office kitchen or villa, or you are a contractor on a new project, Rahis Sheikh Trading supports you from planning and design to manufacturing, installation, maintenance and training.
